title: Black intermission quartet and union integration
summary: Black musicians' intermission group at the Famous Door, when bands integrated and the unions merged.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: I just barely remember her myself sitting there. In fact, that was kind of a strange setup when you start to think about it now. The different intermission bands I had there.
Yeah. Well, when we were there mostly Smiley and Joe, we had the quartet.
And very different from Sharky. That was an entirely different sound.

Oh yes. Oh yes. We played guitar and alto sax. Teddy Purnell played alto. Smiley and Joe played guitar. Alton Purnell played piano. Alonzo Duke Stewart played drums. They were all black men. See, we weren't at that time playing together in mixed colors.
